messages:
Sam: Overnight handoff — quick summary.
Sam: Current incidents: 1) embed-evictions P2 in eu-west1 causing elevated 5xxs for embeddings routes. 2) regen-latency brief spike (tail) around 02:40 UTC.
Sam: What I did: scaled kvproxy pool + bumped embed-host replicas (eu-west1) at 03:15, extended cache TTL for known hot keys, started rolling restart on embed-host-12.
Sam: Mitigations in place: - autoscaler held extra capacity for 30m - temporary fallback route to small-embed-v2 created as a canary (10%) - throttling policy applied to noisy client (client-4387) for 30m.
Alex: Any concrete errors in the logs we can point to?
Sam: Main patterns: `kvproxy: pool exhausted` and occasional `embed-worker OOM` around 02:50-03:05. Snippet:
```
ERROR kvproxy: pool exhausted connecting to embed-host-12
WARN embed-worker: OOM while processing batch size=64
```
Sam: Suspect combined spike + one degraded host. Will investigate memory growth on embed-host-12.
Maria: I'm taking client-4387 offline for throttling and reached out to their infra lead. Also doubled swap on embed-host-12 before restart to reduce OOM risk.
Jordan: I'll keep the autoscaler pinned for eu-west1 until 05:00 UTC and monitor queue depth. If errors >3% I'll flip fallback to full small-embed-v2.
Alex: Can we validate the canary before flipping the fallback?
Sam: Canary is live (10%) as of 03:35. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/routing/canary/12345
oncall-bot: deploy: canary-route small-embed-v2 -> success (build #5421) <https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/5421|view>
Maria: Blockers: none remaining. Follow-ups: 1) investigate possible memory leak on embed-host-12, 2) postmortem if same behavior repeats within 24h.
Jordan: Action items for next shift: - watch eu-west1 embed errors and queue depth - if embed error rate >3% switch fallback to small-embed-v2 full and notify infra - coordinate with @Maria on host memory troubleshooting.
Sam: Leaving handoff: healthy enough, mitigations in place, canary running. Escalate to @Alex/@Jordan after 06:00 UTC if things regress. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks Sam — I'll take morning checks and follow up on postmortem if needed.
Sam: end of thread
